scoring_justification: All quantities are deterministic from given inputs; checker recomputes Theta_D, N_EF, lambda_ep using identical formulas and tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: expected computed values for Theta_D, N_EF, lambda_ep
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table I and stated formulas
hidden_assets.generation_method: recomputed by checker from fixed inputs using identical formulas at verification time
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The gold is derived deterministically from public inputs and formulas; the checker recomputes to avoid any inconsistency between stored gold and the actual reference computation.

schema.description: Object with keys for each compound, each containing the three computed numeric fields.

outputs.description: Computed Debye temperature, electronic density of states at the Fermi level, and electron-phonon coupling constant for MoTe₂ and MoTe₁.₈S₀.₂. The hidden checker recomputes the same quantities from the same fixed inputs and compares to these values within pre-defined absolute tolerances.

output_contract.notes: All constants and formulas are provided. The checker recomputes the three quantities for each compound from the same inputs and expects the submitted values to match within pre-defined absolute tolerances. The output contract now specifies metric_recompute because the verifier does not require an exact bitwise match.
